verdict.rationale: Although Sai is itself an agent, first-party platform docs say it ships an official MCP server, `@simular-ai/sai-mcp`. They list it as a supported interface next to the HTTPS API and Python SDK, and say coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor connect to Sai through it. That makes the server axis applicable, and the core story is delivered. Missing for 10: setup/configuration documentation and the exposed tool list for the MCP server, and independent or hands-on confirmation that it works.
